lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 primary vertical white line segments; inter-line spacing is approximately constant across the mid-torso, narrowing at the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Spatial bifurcation observed at the dorsal terminus where the 8th and 9th lines (counting from anterior) converge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1 and 2 terminate in the upper third of the torso; line 10 exhibits a fragmentation/gap in the mid-region.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Grouping of 4 discrete white spots on the upper hind limb/haunch area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-haunch exhibit a horizontal linear alignment relative to the horizontal axis of the animal.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast white transverse band on the lower radius/ulna region and a white patch on the ventral neck.
